perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Thacker Pass is approaching peak construction and is supported by multiple capital channels including the DOE loan, strategic capital and the August convertible financing.
Designed 40,000 tpa battery-grade lithium carbonate capacity preserves a strategically relevant domestic-supply opportunity, but remains pre-commissioning.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Physical construction progress is the key execution signal; financing and designed capacity are not substitutes for commissioning, qualification, realized output or operating economics.
The financing stack improves runway while adding dilution/credit complexity.

unknowns: remaining contingency versus total project cost
commissioning curve and realized operating cost
